articles.title: UK's New Prime Minister Opens a Special Office in Manchester—and It's Not Just for Show!
articles.summary: Britain's new leader, Andy Burnham, had a super busy first week. He cut electricity taxes, capped bus fares, and opened a second office in Manchester. He says it's about sharing power outside London.

articles.title: Trump Cracks Jokes (and Insults) at Rescheduled White House Correspondents' Dinner
articles.summary: President Trump finally attended the White House Correspondents' Dinner, months after a shooting canceled it. He made jokes—some nice, some mean—and even teased running for a third term, which isn't allowed.

articles.title: Can Foreign Hackers Really Change Your Vote? What Experts Say About Voting Machine Security
articles.summary: A top US official said foreign enemies can hack voting machines and flip votes. But experts say while machines have weaknesses, there's no proof of real attacks. Paper ballots help keep elections safe.
